spec: Implement `crud_op`: handle a CRUD operation on the data store. op 1 reads the value at key (the store returns Ok(key * 10) for known keys and Err("not found") otherwise); op 2 writes value at key, returning Ok(0) on success and Err("storage full") otherwise. Known keys are those with id below 1000. Any other op is rejected with Err("bad op"). The caller must detect when the store's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: db_get
db_put

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} db_get(key: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires key > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (key < 1000)

method {:extern}{:axiom} db_put(key: int, value: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires key > 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (key < 1000)
